Type: shelf
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Diamond Floating Wall Mounted Shelves - 30.5 x 24 x 9.25 Inches, Wood and Metal
Colors: Black
Materials: Wood
These wood and metal shelves combine vintage and modern touches. Supported by eye-catching metalwork, they're ideal for holding spices in a kitchen or treasured objects in a living room or hall. They arrive ready to hang, all hardware included. 9.25"D x 24"W x 30.5"H Engineered firwood shelves with iron frame Avoid moisture. Wipe with soft dry cloth.
